headline: Nifty IT index rallies 3% as major tech stocks climb
hook: Nifty IT index surges 3% in session
summary: The Nifty IT index recorded a 3% gain during the trading session. Major constituents including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Mphasis, HCL Tech, Oracle Financial Services, Tech Mahindra, and Coforge participated in the upward move. The rally reflects a broad-based positive sentiment across the Indian information technology sector.
why_it_matters: IT sector mutual fund holdings see immediate valuation boost
winners_losers: IT shareholders gain / No clear losers

headline: Oracle Financial Services Software files postal ballot scrutinizer report
summary: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited has submitted its scrutinizer report and voting results for a recent postal ballot to the stock exchanges. This routine regulatory filing documents shareholder approval on resolutions put to vote remotely. Such procedural compliance is required for corporate governance transparency in listed entities. Indian retail shareholders can note the completion of this governance formality without any direct impact on stock valuation or earnings.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no immediate financial impact.
